title: Obí nke enyo enyo
intro: Chee echiche banyere ala dị anya nke akụnụba na ịma mma ebe a na-efe anyanwụ kama Onye Okike ya. Akwụkwọ ozi bịarutere nwere oku a na-apụghị ileghara anya, njem amalitekwa ịga n'ụlọikpe karịrị nke a hụrụ mbụ. N'ebe ahụ, a ga-ekpughe nrọ ụgha site n'ala nke na-eduhie anya, oge doro anya ga-agbanwekwa ihe niile.
clues: Achị m ala bara ọgaranya nke ndị mmadụ ya kpọọrọ anyanwụ isiala kama ịkpọ Allah.
Enwetara m akwụkwọ ozi dị nsọ nke na-akpọ m ka m ghara ibuli onwe m elu kama ka m bịa n'okpuru Allah.
Aga m na kansụl m ma buru ụzọ họrọ ọrụ mmekọrịta mba ọzọ, zitere m onyinye iji nwalee onye zitere ya.
Abịara m na Sulayman, e wee gosi m ocheeze m n'ụzọ e ji kpuchie onwe ya iji nwalee nnabata m.
M banyere n'obí eze dị elu nke m chere na ala iko dị nro dị ka mmiri miri emi.
Ekwupụtara m nrubeisi m nye Allah, Onyenwe ụwa nile.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Nwanne nwanyị nke Mozis
Nwunye Abu Lahab
Nwunye Noa
Bilqis, onye ọchịchị Saba
Zulaikha, Nwunye Al-Aziz

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Azụ̀ ukwu loro ya n'ime omimi nke oké osimiri
M na-arịa ọrịa ruo ọtụtụ afọ na ọnwụ ezinụlọ m.
E nyere iwu ka e chụọ nwa a hụrụ n'anya n'àjà ná nrọ
A nwalere ya site n'oche eze ahụ e ji ihe mkpuchi kpuchie na obí eze nke iko.
A tụbara ya n'ọkụ na-ere ọkụ maka imebi arụsị
trial.answer: A nwalere ya site n'oche eze ahụ e ji ihe mkpuchi kpuchie na obí eze nke iko.

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: E wuru Igbe ahụ n'elu mmiri
Ọgba mgbaba maka ndị na-ehi ụra
Ala nke obí kristal (Sarh)
Osimiri Naịl n'oge ndị ahụ a pụchara
Ọkụ nke ndị na-ekpere arụsị kwadebere

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Ala loro m ya na akụ m
Ọ nọgidere n'ekweghị ekwe, e bibikwara ya na ndị m
E rubere ya na Sulayman nye Allah, Onyenwe ụwa
Mmiri gbawara m n'oké osimiri ka m na-achụ ndị kwere ekwe
A gbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ nkume maka imebi Ụbọchị Izu Ike
outcome.answer: E rubere ya na Sulayman nye Allah, Onyenwe ụwa

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
